reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread on her message in #north-random. I said the update was noted: the Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines has a 26 August deadline and there's nothing to do yet.

I also asked her which year she means. It's 14 October 2026 now, so 26 August this year has already gone by. She probably means 26 August 2027, but I didn't assume that.

The workspace brain saved her message as she posted it, so the deadline is on record. I took no other action because she said nothing was needed yet.
